description_en: Queries the observability capacity unit (OCU) usage data of Real User Monitoring (RUM)
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-rum-ocu-statistic-data --start-time 1600063200000 --end-time 1687849260000 --query-type TIME_SERIES --filter Value=b590xxxxx@2dcbxxxxx9_,_b590xxxxx@2dcbxxxxx8 OpType=in Key=pid --group siteType --page 1 --page-size 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou

*   startTime: The total number of OCUs is grouped by start time.
